name: 4-tert-butylcyclohexanol
description: 4-tert-Butylcyclohexanol (CAS 21862-63-5 ), also known commercially as Padaryl, is a fragrance and flavor ingredient used across personal care and consumer goods formulations. It delivers a clean, woody, camphoraceous character that perfumers and flavorists select to build or modify scent profiles. In fine fragrance and functional perfumery, it contributes a fresh, woody note and is used to construct accords in soaps, detergents, and fabric care products. As a FEMA 4724 -listed flavoring agent, it qualifies for use in food and beverage applications. Its subtle camphoraceous character supports specific flavor profiles in various edible products. In personal care formulations, including shampoos, body washes, and skin creams, it functions as a fragrance component, providing lasting scent performance. Household and industrial cleaning products also incorporate it to deliver controlled, pleasant odor profiles at use concentrations. The compound is valued for its stability and versatility across a wide range of pH levels and product bases. 4-tert-Butylcyclohexanol is supplied as a liquid, typically in both cis and trans isomeric forms or as a mixture. The isomeric ratio influences the odor character and buyer selection for specific aromatic applications. It is available in fragrance-grade and flavor-grade specifications to meet the requirements of different end markets. Standard packaging ranges from drums to IBC containers for industrial quantities to ensure safe transport and storage. The material is produced to high quality standards to ensure consistency in every batch.
